modelRoles: The suggestion model reviews current sources. JEV adds numeric scores after publication; scores do not decide findings or review completion. Both are independent of the conversation model.
automaticPending: Use the manual Note review in the left preview. Git automation will be available after integration, disabled by default.

mcpHelp.label: About MCP integration
mcpHelp.title: What MCP integration provides
mcpHelp.intro: Give your terminal agent access to original project Notes and existing Janus review suggestions.
mcpHelp.reading: Find Notes by module, type or keyword. Read sources, versions and related context to understand requirements, designs and decisions.
mcpHelp.writing: Create, edit, move or delete Notes under existing authorization, with structure and version checks. Preview minimal Note repository initialization for new projects.
mcpHelp.suggestions: Read existing issues, evidence and stale status. Clear explicitly handled or declined findings; clearing does not edit Note content.
mcpHelp.workflow: Keep your existing Note workflow and use MCP only to read and clear suggestions. All tools remain available, with guidance to check suggestions before maintenance and at closeout; there is no automatic suggestions-only mode.
mcpHelp.boundary: Import registers the terminal connection without rewriting workflow rules or starting reviews. It works while the desktop is closed; basic operations make no model calls.

mcpIntro: Import once in each terminal. Every tool call names its workspace. Restart or reload the terminal after changing configuration.
mcpUnavailable: Note MCP build is unavailable. Rebuild or repair the application.
mcpProbePassed: Service handshake and Note read passed. This does not verify a call inside the terminal.

mcpState.conflict: Name conflict — resolve the janusx-note entry in the terminal configuration

automaticHelp: Starts at the current commit when enabled. Counts all commits, reviews changed Notes, and checks ordinary merges early. Runs quietly while Janus is open. Configure and test the generation model first.

reason.no-git: This project is not using Git yet
reason.detached: Switch to a Git branch to run automatic review
reason.no-commits: Waiting for the first Git commit
reason.git-conflicts: Resolve Git conflicts to continue automatic review
reason.history-changed: Git history changed; turn automatic review off and on to reset its baseline
reason.review-failed: Some Notes could not be reviewed; retry from the Note preview
reason.coverage-incomplete: Some Notes need changes before review can be retried
reason.handled-retry: Some handled Notes need another review
reason.sources-unavailable: Unable to read review sources or checkpoints; retrying
